thread: mira: Quick design question — thinking about required-field affordances across the console. Do we keep the asterisk on labels, or switch to a subtle 'Required' helper under the label? Also: delete confirmations — should org-level destructive actions use typed-confirm, and smaller deletes rely on an undo snackbar? Attaching a screenshot of the current form. josh: I vote +1 for asterisk. It's compact and people scan labels quickly. The 'Required' line feels like extra noise, especially on dense forms. eva: Accessibility note: a visual asterisk isn't announced by screen readers. If we keep/remove it we must set aria-required="true" and include clear error messaging. Otherwise SR users miss the affordance. liam: On inline errors — prefer show-on-blur for fields where users are likely to type a lot (eg description) and show-on-submit for multi-field batch actions. Keeps noise down. Also avoid immediately showing red on focus. mira: Good recs. For delete: my thinking — typed-confirm ("type ORGANIZATION NAME to confirm") for irreversible org-wide deletes and data-destructive ops; undo snackbar for things like removing a member or deleting a single dataset. Keeps flow fast but safe. sara: +1 to that pattern. We should codify a threshold: typed-confirm when operation cannot be recovered from backups or has legal/regulatory impact. Otherwise undo is fine. I'll add to the product pattern doc. josh: Mobile real-estate thing: asterisk + long label cause wrap. 'Required' under the label might actually be less janky on mobile if we style it small. But could be redundant if we also show inline helper text. mira: Prototype suggestion (html): ``` We'll only use this for login ``` If we remove the star visually, keep aria-required and add a programmatic hint. eva: Exactly — aria-required + an accessible description like `required` in the label text or via aria-describedby. That covers SR users without adding visual clutter. liam: Regarding errors vs summary: for long forms we still need a top summary that lists missing fields after submit, but inline errors should still highlight each field. Summary alone is not enough. mira: Action items: 1) Design team to try a compact 'required' helper under label on mobile and asterisk on desktop, 2) engineering to ensure aria-required is present for all required inputs, 3) product to write rules for typed-confirm vs undo and add examples. @sara can you own the doc? :thumbsup: sara: I'll take it. I'll draft rules + examples and link back here. design-bot: Added to UX backlog (#1234) and linked PR template for typed-confirm patterns. josh: Cool. Also can we run a quick screen-reader sanity check before we ship? 5-10min with assistive tech will save headaches. mira: Agreed. I'll schedule a quick session. Thanks all :sparkles:
